open_questions.topic: Long pizza name truncation in PizzaCard
open_questions.detail: Figma text nodes for 'Funghi Selvatici & Tartufo' (6:77) and 'Prosciutto Crudo e Rucola' (6:101) are authored as full, single-line strings in the tree, but the rendered PNG clips both to an ellipsis ('Funghi Selvatici &...', 'Prosciutto Crudo e...') because the name competes with the price on the same fixed-width row. The structural JSON and the authoritative-for-visuals PNG disagree on the visible result.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Implement PizzaCard's name as a single-line, ellipsis-truncated field (matching the rendered PNG), with the full name exposed via a title/aria-label attribute for accessibility.

options.label: Truncate to one line with ellipsis — matches the rendered PNG for nodes 6:77 and 6:101
Wrap the name onto a second line, pushing price/description down — matches the full text authored in nodes 6:77 and 6:101
Auto-shrink the name's font-size to fit one line without truncation or wrapping

open_questions.topic: Duplicate cart entry points in the header
open_questions.detail: The header has both a 'Cart' text nav-link (6:18) and a separate cart icon button with an item-count badge (6:22). The static frame does not show whether these lead to the same destination or represent different affordances (e.g. a full cart page vs. a mini-cart drawer).
open_questions.arc_assumption: Treat both as navigation to the same /cart destination; no separate drawer behavior is implied by the design.

open_questions.detail: The frame is a single fixed-width (1440px) desktop artboard. No tablet/mobile variant, breakpoints, or reflow behavior is defined for the 4-column pizza grid, the hero's two-column split, the delivery-banner's two-block layout, or the footer's 3-column layout.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Build each proposed component responsively using the distilled spacing/type scale and conventional breakpoints (stack the hero, collapse the 4-col grid to 2-then-1 column, stack the footer columns), without a design reference to validate the collapsed states against.

open_questions.topic: Web font sourcing for Fraunces & Geist
open_questions.detail: The frame specifies 'Fraunces' (display serif) and 'Geist' (body sans) but nothing in the file indicates whether these should be self-hosted, loaded from Google Fonts, or are already a project dependency.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Load both as variable webfonts covering the weights actually used in the type ramp (400/500/600 for Geist, 600/700 for Fraunces), via whichever hosting approach the project's build already supports.

open_questions.topic: Cart count and ETA are static copy in the design file
open_questions.detail: The header cart badge shows a literal '3' (6:24) and the ETA reads 'Estimated delivery: 30 mins' (6:21) as static design copy.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Treat both as dynamic values bound to real cart/delivery state (props: cartCount, etaMinutes) rather than hardcoded copy.
